stagecraft_leads.entity: Physical stage curtain; Jan Groth's Strekkomposisjon i broderi
stagecraft_leads.place_link: Commissioned for 1985 opening of this building's Hovudscenen; physically sewn together in the theatre foyer.
stagecraft_leads.physical_detail: 12 connected panels of dark brown-black cotton, white embroidered line, about 9.5 by 22 metres; the panels are one object, not twelve.
stagecraft_leads.boundary: Art photographer's and Jan Groth artwork's rights are separate. Preserve official source link only; do not copy theatre photo. Caption mentions 2014 death while biography states 2022; do not certify photography date.

stagecraft_leads.entity: Printed theatre programme for Det Norske Teatret's Les Misérables (1988)
stagecraft_leads.physical_detail: Sceneweb identifies a 32-page illustrated Nynorsk paper theatre programme, digitized by the National Library in 2022.
stagecraft_leads.place_link: Sceneweb explicitly links the programme record to Hovudscenen, a venue established 1985 at Kristian IVs gate 8.
stagecraft_leads.boundary: Digital facsimile/scan establishes a named programme edition, not an inspected extant paper exemplar at this specific site, nor permission to republish its digital pages. Do not confuse Sceneweb multimedia record with an already identified canonical physical Object.

foyer_painting.boundary: A legitimate physical foyer painting, but not a substitute for a coherent scenekunst-led Objects collection.
